_comment: DSHOT600 analogue of period_tally_short.json - K-candidate rx_speed retest for the fixed-ratio RX sampling plan (decision/ADR-002-bidirectional-dshot.md). Channel 1 only. Shorter duration than the DSHOT300 version: DSHOT600 replies land at roughly 2x the rate, so the same 8000ms window would produce ~9500 records against a pipeline proven at ~4743 (period_tally_short.json/2026-09-12_13-04-36) - trimmed to keep each candidate's capture comparable in record count and avoid stressing the SD write path in an already-tight retest loop.
